text:
emma: Heads-up — OrionX v1 bring-up failing locale checks. BLEU delta ~10% on zh/ko slice, and several he/ar samples show bracket/quote mirroring.
raj: Oof. Any tiny repros we can paste?
emma: Pasting two minimal repros we keep seeing in the runner.

```
input (zh): 我们去了公园，孩子们玩得很开心。
gold (en): We went to the park; the kids had a great time.
pred (en): We went to the park the kids had very fun
```

```
input (ko): 저희는 학교에 갔습니다요。
gold (en): We went to school.
pred (en): We went to schoolyo
```

emma: For zh the onboard tokenizer merges the ideographic comma token with previous han characters, shifting token indices. For ko the josa '\uc694' is being fused onto the noun token.
nora: Did training use any unicode normalization?
emma: Train pipeline used byte-level pretokenizer + no unicode normalization. Onboard runtime defaulted to NFD + collapse-zwsp and also picked up a new bigram token added during vocab refresh. Combo seems to cause merge.
kevin: New vocab token? that can definitely change token boundaries even without normalization. Worth revert or pin vocab.
raj: What about RTL case?
emma: Example he->en repro below.

```
input (he): שלום (המשפט) — האם הכל בסדר?
gold (en): Hello (the sentence)  is everything ok?
pred (en): Hello )the sentence(  is everything ok?
```

emma: Brackets show mirrored order in pred, looks like logical vs visual reordering after preprocessing. Suspect removal of RLM/LRM or bidi control chars in normalization step.
nora: Is this on quant only?
kevin: We see it on fp16 too, but q4/q5 runs amplify token merges and make BLEU delta worse. fp16 shows fewer mirrored brackets but still some cases.
ops-bot: eval-runner-318246: orionx-v1 multilingual sweep (n=1800) completed — 162 flagged samples (regression threshold 5%). Report: s3://rwd-evals/orionx/v1/3182468102/report.json
raj: Actionable plan: 1) run a quick canary reverting onboard normalizer to training parity (disable NFD + collapse-zwsp), 2) pin previous vocab to see if bigram token is responsible, 3) run kvcache-aligned smoke with token index traces, 4) compare fp16 vs q4/q5 to quantify amplification.
kevin: Also add a bidi unit test that asserts bracket/quote logical order preserved through preproc. And add per-locale BLEU alerts for zh/ko/he/ar with a tighter threshold (2%).
nora: I'll add the tests and update eval-runner to emit per-locale diffs.
emma: I'll start the bisect: vocab pin -> normalization -> pretokenizer config -> quant tokenizer kernel. Kicking off canary now, will post results. tagging @raj @kevin. :thumbsup:
